content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or equivalent with First Class (minimum 60% marks or 6.0 CGPA); Followed by a Master's degree in Structural Engineering, Construction Technology and Management, or Coastal Management, with First Class (minimum 60% marks or 6.0 CGPA), from a recognised university Age limit: Maximum 35 years Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement for one year on contract basis. Extendable for 1 more year based on the performance of the candidate and availability of fund.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIT Calicut Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview (offline/hybrid) Applications are shortlisted. Eligible shortlisted candidates are notified by email and invited for the interview. Interview is offline/hybrid on 04-12-2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets and certificates in support of academic qualification and experience No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form annexed to the notice. Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of mark sheets and certificates supporting academic qualification and experience. Consolidate all soft copies into a single PDF document. E-mail it to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] . Use the subject line "Application for Project Associate – I /CoEUPD/P13". Send the application by 30-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photograph submitted. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 30,000 per month + 20% HRA = Rs. 36,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
